verdict.rationale: Docs describe the full programmatic evaluation loop: create a dataset from examples (docs-7/25), define evaluators (docs-8/21/26), execute the app on the dataset to produce an experiment (docs-9/27), and the SDK (langsmith-gh-1) confirms programmatic client usage; an official MCP server (probe-4) also lets an agent drive LangSmith directly. missing for 10: an end-to-end code sample showing dataset creation + eval trigger + result read-back in one flow, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the agent-driven (MCP) workflow actually returning eval results.
